_about: 1,4-Dioxane (1) + Water (2): total pressures against temperature, 288.15-308.15 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of 1,4-dioxane, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: A. V. Kurzin, A. N. Evdokimov, V. B. Antipina, O. S. Pavlova, V. E. Gusev, Vapor Pressures for 1,4-Dioxane + Tetrabutylammonium Nitrate, Water + Tetrabutylammonium Nitrate, and 1,4-Dioxane + Water + Tetrabutylammonium Nitrate, J. Chem. Eng. Data 53 (2008) 207-210
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 6. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
